description:
## About Hackman X

Ten years ago, Hackman began at DSCE, bringing students together to build, experiment, and turn their ideas into projects. Today, it stands as the oldest hackathon at DSCE and one of the oldest student hackathons in Bengaluru. Now, as we return for our **10th edition**, we're excited to celebrate a decade of Hackman with all of you!

Organised by **GENESIS**, the student club of the Department of Information Science & Engineering at Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering, Hackman X is a **24-hour offline hackathon** happening at the DSCE campus.

Got an idea you've been waiting to work on? Want to try something you've never built before? Or just want to spend 24 hours coding, figuring things out with your team, and turning an idea into something real? This is your chance!


## What's in it for you? 👀

- **Cash prizes and more!** Compete for cash prizes and exciting rewards from our sponsors.
- **Render credits:** All attendees can claim $50 in Render building credits through a dedicated link we'll share during the hackathon.
- **A domain of your own:** Every member of the teams selected for the final offline round will receive a .xyz domain.
- **Mentorship:** Get guidance from mentors and industry professionals as you work on your project.
- **New connections:** Meet fellow builders, exchange ideas, and find people who are just as excited about tech as you are.

And of course, you get to be part of **Hackman's 10th edition**, a milestone we're genuinely excited to celebrate!

## Ready to join us?

Get your team together, start thinking about what you want to build, and send in your application. We can't wait to see what you come up with!

hackathon_faqs.answer: No. Hackman X is an open hackathon, which means there are no fixed tracks or restricted themes. You can build any innovative project that solves a real-world problem using any domain, stack, or idea you believe in.
hackathon_faqs.question: Are there any tracks for the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Hackman X is open to all undergraduate and postgraduate students from recognized engineering, technology, and science colleges across India. All branches and skill levels are welcomed.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who is eligible to participate in Hackman X?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Teams must consist of 2 to 4 members. Inter-college teams are fully permitted. Every member must be a registered student with a valid college ID.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is the required team size?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Bring your laptops, chargers, extension cords, student ID cards, any specialized hardware/sensors you plan to use, and personal toiletries for the overnight stay. Important to bring a lot of creativity because you'll need it !
hackathon_faqs.question: What can we bring to the venue?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No. To ensure fair competition, all code, UI designs, and prototypes must be created during the 24-hour hackathon window. You may utilize open-source libraries, public APIs, and pre-trained models.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can we work on a pre-built project?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes, full hospitality is arranged on the DSCE campus. This includes meals, midnight snacks, beverages, dedicated resting lounges, and 24/7 security.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will accommodation and meals be provided?

prizes.desc: The winning team will receive ₹40,000 in cash, along with a 2-year CodeCrafters VIP membership worth $720 for every team member. The membership provides access to hands-on coding challenges covering Git, Redis, Docker, SQLite and more.
prizes.name: Winner Prize Amount

prizes.desc: The second-place team will receive ₹20,000 in cash, along with a 1-year CodeCrafters VIP membership worth $360 for every team member. The membership provides access to hands-on coding challenges covering Git, Redis, Docker, SQLite and more.
prizes.name: 1st Runner-up Prize amount

prizes.desc: The third-place team will receive ₹10,000 in cash, along with a 6-month CodeCrafters VIP membership worth $180 for every team member. The membership provides access to hands-on coding challenges covering Git, Redis, Docker, SQLite and more.
prizes.name: 2nd Runner-up Prize Amount

prizes.desc: $500 in Render credits for the Best Use of Render track winner. Render Workflows must be used to qualify.
